name: Pezuela de las Torres (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the arms of Pezuela de las Torres beneath a marquess's crown (a fleur-de-lis and chequy on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Pezuela de las Torres; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pezuela de las Torres arms — fleur-de-lis and chequy on yellow, beneath a marquess's crown
